23992557.reason: declared absent (population AND endpoint mismatch, cross-family definition audit — the most serious of the sweep): ICAP (23992557) enrolled patients with a FIRST ATTACK of acute pericarditis (a primary-prevention population), not recurrent pericarditis, and its primary outcome is the COMPOSITE 'incessant OR recurrent pericarditis'. Our topic is recurrent pericarditis with a 'recurrent pericarditis' outcome. Refuse rather than pool a first-attack composite under a recurrent-pericarditis label. Leaves a clean k=2 pool of the genuine recurrent-pericarditis trials (CORP 21873705, CORP-2 24694983).
